title: Pipeline
description: A pipeline's own declaration: src/main/pipeline/<pipeline>/pipeline.json. Its DIRECTORY is the pipeline name, so the name is not a field here — and a directory cannot hold two entries of one name, which is how uniqueness stops being a check. The filename is uniform (pipeline.json, the kind, not the instance): cli/'s <noun>.json convention marks the bare command's declaration among its verb files, a role that does not exist inside a pipeline directory, and three siblings should share one shape down to the filename. This schema lives beside what it describes rather than under rsc/schema/, which is the data domain: the pipeline declaration is this repo's own interface, not corpus data. Derivables are absent by construction: the remedy command is `yoga pipeline run <name>`, the format history is rsc/schema/<name>/<schemas[0]>/CHANGELOG.md, and the cache root comes from rsc/cache_io.csv — each a function of the name, so declaring them could only contradict the derivation.

schemas.description: The schema names under rsc/schema/<pipeline>/ this pipeline's data validates against. Order is load-bearing: the FIRST entry is the schema whose CHANGELOG.md anchors the pipeline's format history.

input.description: The repo-relative directory under data/input/ the pipeline reads. The one committed authority for this path: run.sh reads it from here rather than restating it.

input_glob.description: The glob under input that selects one datum. A trailing slash selects directories; no trailing slash selects files.

subject_depth.description: How many path components under the pipeline's cache root name one subject.

extra_input_glob.description: A second input shape the pipeline demands beyond input_glob, at the same subject depth; the trailing-slash convention is per glob. Empty when the pipeline has one shape.

diagnostic_skip.description: Diagnostics to skip beyond the universal versioned-schema skip set, each named for the deviation it licenses. Empty when the pipeline deviates nowhere.
